```{r}
#| label: textbook-refs
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
# Lists the textbook sections that cover this page's topic, read from
# data/textbook-refs.csv (one row per page, book and section).
# `book` is a key in references.bib; the section and page range are
# the textbook's own, from its table of contents.
textbook_refs <- read.csv(
  "data/textbook-refs.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8"
)
# Quarto hands knitr an intermediate file such as "estimation.rmarkdown".
this_page <- sub("\\..*$", "", basename(knitr::current_input()))
page_refs <- textbook_refs[textbook_refs$page == this_page, ]

if (nrow(page_refs) > 0) {
  cat("## Textbook cross-references {.unnumbered}\n\n")
  cat("Textbook sections on the topics of this page:\n\n")
  items <- sprintf(
    "- @%s [%s]: %s\n",
    page_refs$book,
    page_refs$locator,
    page_refs$topic
  )
  cat(items, sep = "")
}
```
